sourceQaIssues.finding: Text.End use-case line says 'extract the first few characters', while the function name, example and explanation state it extracts the last three characters.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: No silent repair. Show PRESENTATION CORRECTION if teaching this slide.

sourceQaIssues.finding: Sparklines, Consolidation, Data Entry Form and FILTER search already exist in Week 1.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Reuse Week 1 explanations; only produce new Week 2 behavior (VSTACK/3D refs/ActiveX/VBA).

sourceQaIssues.finding: ActiveX and the VBA TextBox workflow depend on desktop Excel/Windows-style controls and are not universal across Excel environments.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Label environment dependency; do not present as the only search method.

sourceQaIssues.finding: Several chart types are named/shown visually with little or no explanatory text: stacked/clustered variants, Sunburst, Treemap, Funnel, Radar and Combo.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Use source visuals for recognition. Do not invent detailed use-case rules that are not supported by the deck.

sourceQaIssues.finding: IQR, Box Plot/outliers and Standard Deviation concepts were already approved as Statistics prerequisite in Week 1.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Teach only the Excel application layer: QUARTILE.INC, limits, IF/OR flag, Box & Whisker and STANDARDIZE.

sourceQaIssues.finding: Regression is mentioned alongside Solver/Descriptive Statistics, but no regression workflow is taught in this deck.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Do not create a standalone Regression lesson or assessment question from the mention alone.

sourceQaIssues.finding: Python in Excel and Pandas overlap the existing Python/Pandas curriculum.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Keep as Excel automation bridge only; no duplicate Python fundamentals.

sourceQaIssues.finding: The Top 10 Dashboard Mistakes section often supplies a title plus visual example rather than full written reasoning.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Teach the named mistake + what the source visual demonstrates; do not manufacture unsupported rules.

sourceQaIssues.finding: Dashboard questions jump from 1 to 3; question 2 is missing from the supplied deck.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Preserve numbering/source trace; do not invent the missing question.

sourceQaIssues.finding: The M slide states a library size of nearly 1,000 functions; this is not necessary to understand or operate M.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Keep as source context if desired, but exclude the numeric claim from assessment.

sourceQaIssues.finding: Slides contain broad productivity/governance claims (for example a 35% accuracy improvement) and conclusion-style statements.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Do not turn unsourced productivity percentages into assessment facts.

sourceQaIssues.finding: Several assessments require companion Excel/Access files (Lectures 19, 21, 23, 24, 26, 27 and 28) that are not in this uploaded batch.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Study can be produced from slides; practical assessment reproduction stays blocked until companion files are supplied or explicitly waived.

sourceQaIssues.finding: VSTACK is mentioned as a consolidation option but there is no worked VSTACK formula example.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Supporting mention only unless another source later teaches its syntax.

sourceQaIssues.finding: SQLite is presented as an external source via ODBC/add-ins; the source does not provide a detailed driver-installation procedure.
sourceQaIssues.productionAction: Teach connection concept and workflow only; do not invent driver setup steps.
